#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

#define int long long
#define ll long long

const ll INF = 1e17 + 7;
const int MAXN = 1001;

using pii = pair<int, int>;

int dx[4] = {0, 0, -1, 1};
int dy[4] = {-1, 1, 0, 0};

vector<int> graph[MAXN];
bool used[MAXN];
int parent[MAXN];

bool okCell(int x, int y, const vector<string>& board) {
    return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < (int)board.size() && y < (int)board.size() &&
           board[x][y] != 'Y' && board[x][y] != 'Z';
}

vector<vector<int>> bfsFrom(int sx, int sy, const vector<string>& board) {
    int n = (int)board.size();
    vector<vector<int>> dist(n, vector<int>(n, INF));
    queue<pii> q;
    dist[sx][sy] = 0;
    q.push({sx, sy});

    while (!q.empty()) {
        auto [x, y] = q.front();
        q.pop();

        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int nx = x + dx[d];
            int ny = y + dy[d];

            if (!okCell(nx, ny, board) || dist[nx][ny] != INF) continue;

            dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
            q.push({nx, ny});
        }
    }

    return dist;
}

void buildGraph() {
    int n, t;
    cin >> n >> t;

    vector<string> a(n), b(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> a[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> b[i];

    int zx = 0, zy = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (a[i][j] == 'Z') zx = i, zy = j;
        }
    }

    vector<vector<int>> toReactor = bfsFrom(zx, zy, a);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (!okCell(i, j, a)) continue;

            vector<vector<int>> fromStart = bfsFrom(i, j, a);

            for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
                for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                    if (!okCell(x, y, a) || fromStart[x][y] > t || fromStart[x][y] > toReactor[x][y])
                        continue;

                    if (fromStart[x][y] == toReactor[x][y]) {
                        bool good = false;
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int nx = x + dx[d];
                            int ny = y + dy[d];
                            if (!okCell(nx, ny, a) || fromStart[nx][ny] >= toReactor[nx][ny])
                                continue;
                            good = true;
                        }
                        if (!good) continue;
                    }

                    int leftBase = 100 * i + 10 * j;
                    int rightBase = 100 * x + 10 * y;

                    for (int u = 1; u <= a[i][j] - '0'; ++u) {
                        for (int v = 1; v <= b[x][y] - '0'; ++v) {
                            graph[leftBase + u].push_back(rightBase + v);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

bool tryKuhn(int v) {
    if (used[v]) return false;
    used[v] = true;

    for (int to : graph[v]) {
        if (parent[to] == 0 || tryKuhn(parent[to])) {
            parent[to] = v;
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

signed main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
    cin.tie(0);
    cout.tie(0);
    cout.precision(10);

    buildGraph();

    for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) {
        tryKuhn(i);
        fill(used, used + MAXN, false);
    }

    int answer = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) answer += (parent[i] != 0);

    cout << answer;
    return 0;
}

    deque<pair<int,int>> q;
    d[sr][sc] = 0;
    q.push_back(make_pair(sr, sc));

            int nc = cur.second + my[dir];

            if (!reachable(nr, nc, board) || d[nr][nc] != INF) continue;

            d[nr][nc] = d[cur.first][cur.second] + 1;
            q.push_back(make_pair(nr, nc));
        }
    }

    return d;
}

    cin >> n >> timeLimit;

    vector<string> grid1(n), grid2(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> grid1[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> grid2[i];

    int rz = 0, cz = 0;

    vector<vector<int>> toZ = computeDistances(rz, cz, grid1);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {

            if (!reachable(i, j, grid1)) continue;

            vector<vector<int>> cur = computeDistances(i, j, grid1);

            for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
                for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                    if (!reachable(x, y, grid1) || cur[x][y] > timeLimit || cur[x][y] > toZ[x][y])

                    if (cur[x][y] == toZ[x][y]) {

    }

bool augment(int v) {

    vis[v] = true;

    for (int to : adj[v]) {

    int ans = 0;

    int dx[4] = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    int dy[4] = {-1, 1, 0, 0};

    vector<int> graph[MAXN];
    bool used[MAXN];
    int match[MAXN];

    bool cellOk(int x, int y, const vector<string>& board) {
        return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < (int)board.size() && y < (int)board.size() &&
               board[x][y] != 'Y' && board[x][y] != 'Z';
    }

    vector<vector<int>> bfs(int sx, int sy, const vector<string>& board) {

        dist[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.push({sx, sy});

        while (!q.empty()) {
            pair<int,int> v = q.front();
            q.pop();

            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nx = v.first + dx[i];
                int ny = v.second + dy[i];

                if (!cellOk(nx, ny, board) || dist[nx][ny] != INF) continue;

                dist[nx][ny] = dist[v.first][v.second] + 1;
                q.push({nx, ny});
            }
        }

        return dist;
    }

    void addEdge(const vector<string>& a, const vector<string>& b, int i, int j, int x, int y) {
        int L = 100 * i + 10 * j;
        int R = 100 * x + 10 * y;

        for (int u = 1; u <= a[i][j] - '0'; ++u) {
            for (int v = 1; v <= b[x][y] - '0'; ++v) {
                graph[L + u].push_back(R + v);
            }
        }

    bool kuhn(int v) {
        if (used[v]) return false;
        used[v] = true;

        for (int to : graph[v]) {
            if (match[to] == 0 || kuhn(match[to])) {
                match[to] = v;
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

public:
    void run() {
        int n, t;
        cin >> n >> t;

        vector<string> a(n), b(n);
        for (auto& row : a) cin >> row;
        for (auto& row : b) cin >> row;

        int zx = 0, zy = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
